messaging.title: Messages
messaging.undecryptable: This message cannot be read with this device's key.
messaging.peerHasNoKey: This member has not activated encrypted messaging yet.

encryption.title: Encrypted messaging
encryption.explainTitle: What the server sees, and what it does not
encryption.explain: Your messages are encrypted on your device before they are sent. The Inbox server carries data it cannot open: it knows the sender, the recipient, the ad concerned and the date, but never the content.
encryption.keyStays: Your private key stays on this device. It is never sent to Inbox in the clear.
encryption.createText: A key pair will be created on this device. This takes a moment.
encryption.restoreText: A key already exists for your account, but this device does not have it. Enter your secret phrase to restore it.
encryption.restoreNoBackup: No backup has been saved for this account.
encryption.resetText: If you have lost your secret phrase, you can create a new key. Messages you already received will then become permanently unreadable.
encryption.resetConfirm: Creating a new key will make your old messages permanently unreadable. Continue?
encryption.backupText: Encrypt your private key with a secret phrase so you can restore it on another device. Inbox only stores the encrypted result, and cannot open it.
encryption.backupHint: Choose a long phrase and write it down. Nobody can give it back to you.
encryption.backupMismatch: The two phrases do not match.
encryption.fingerprintHint: Read these characters aloud with your contact to be sure you are talking directly to each other.
encryption.keyChangedText: This happens when they reinstall the app or change device. If you were not expecting it, check their fingerprint with them before continuing.

reportDialog.title: Report this conversation
reportDialog.explain: Inbox cannot read your messages. So that moderation can review this report, the messages in this conversation will be decrypted on your device and sent in the clear to our team.
reportDialog.consent: I agree to send the content of this conversation to Inbox moderation.
reportDialog.messageCount: {count} message will be sent | {count} messages will be sent
reportDialog.sent: Report sent. Our team will review it.

demoPayment.success: Payment confirmed. Your Pro subscription is active.
